description: This file defines the AWS AccountClient class, which is a client for interacting with the AWS Account service. It primarily includes method annotations for various operations related to account management, such as updating contact information and managing regions.

classes.name: AccountClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS Account service, extending AwsClient.

methods.name: acceptPrimaryEmailUpdate
methods.description: Initiates acceptance of primary email update for AWS account.

methods.name: deleteAlternateContact
methods.description: Deletes an alternate contact for the AWS account.

methods.name: disableRegion
methods.description: Disables a specified AWS region for the account.

methods.name: enableRegion
methods.description: Enables a specified AWS region for the account.

methods.name: getAlternateContact
methods.description: Retrieves an alternate contact for the account.

methods.name: getContactInformation
methods.description: Gets contact information for the AWS account.

methods.name: getPrimaryEmail
methods.description: Retrieves the primary email address associated with the account.

methods.name: putAlternateContact
methods.description: Sets or updates an alternate contact.

methods.name: putContactInformation
methods.description: Updates contact information for the account.

methods.name: startPrimaryEmailUpdate
methods.description: Starts the process to update the primary email.
